items.title: AMLR and AMLD6: Why Perpetual KYC and KYS Must Be Automated
items.summary_short: The AMLR (Regulation (EU) 2024/1624) applies from 10 July 2027 and sets fixed outer limits for KYC updates: at least annually for higher-risk customers and at least every five years for all others, plus event-driven reviews. AMLD6 (Directive (EU) 2024/1640) strengthens the...
